01569 Gil`adiy {gil-a:-di:'}

源自 01568 的種族名稱; TWOT - 356a; 形容詞

欽定本 - Gileadite 11; 11

基列人 = "嶙峋的區域"
1) 基列居民
2) 瑪拿西支派, 基列的後代
3) 耶弗他, 基列的兒子
record.edic_text:
01569 Gil`adiy {ghil-aw-dee'}

patronymically from 01568; TWOT - 356a; adj

AV - Gileadite 11; 11

Gileadite = "rocky region"
1) an inhabitant of Gilead
2) a branch of the tribe of Manasseh, descended of Gilead
3) of Jephthah as the son of Gilead
